Findings triage — routing repair + grade.

**Routing** — added **`domain:spec`**; routing only, **`finding` grade unchanged, no ownership taken**. Landing rationale: all three priced dispositions run through `packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts` (document the equivalence, document the divergence, or retire the member), and disposition 3 is ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove territory — the same family as #5295 / #5703, both `domain:spec`. Dispositions 1 and 3 change contract behavior/surface, so this is the semantic face, not `spec-surface`; the reverse red line keeps behavior-affecting cards in `domain:spec`.

**Anchors verified on `origin/main` @ `3a1d9c7`** — `getObject` required member at `packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts:334` with no equivalence sentence; the two divergent implementations at `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts:1370` (delegates to `get('object', name)`) and `packages/objectql/src/metadata-facade.ts:104` (delegates to `registry.getObject`). Dedup: `getObject` in:title — only this card.

**Grade: hold as `finding`** — contract-documentation gap; nothing a user hits today (the one consumer that stumbled, #6055, already paid its way around it and documented the trade). Why still held rather than promoted: the disposition choice itself is the work, and it needs the spec seat's pricing pass, not a dev dispatch. Note for the spec seat: this card is also a member of the "TypeScript export/contract surface" boundary family flagged to the maintainer on 2026-08-08 (seat-post comment, #4593/#5507/#5975) — if that ruling lands, it may re-route this card.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
